title: Model games by structure

D0.outcome: Explains that games sharing a pawn structure share plans.

D1.outcome: Given three model games from one structure family, names the plan each side follows.

D2.outcome: Given a new game from the family, predicts the plan class at three points before the moves are shown.

D3.outcome: Identifies the move at which a game leaves the family and what changed.

sources: docs/council-synthesis.md CD-8 (games curated into families by structure)
conditions: Families are grouped by structure; commentary is original, moves are facts.
contrasts: A game that has left the structure but is still read with the family's plan.
Families chosen by opening name instead of structure.
A game with no clear structure.
